caption: The drawing depicts a brown leather belt with a round, metal buckle that has the word "POLICE" embossed on it. Hanging from the belt is a brown handled police baton (nightstick) with a textured grip and a rounded top. Attached near the top of the baton is a decorative blue-gray tassel with a knotted end and a looped cord. The objects are drawn with detailed shading and highlights, giving them a realistic appearance, and are set against a plain, neutral beige background. The artist's signature and date "Lavinia A. Stack 1939" appear in the lower right corner.
title: Police Club and Belt
